prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single “best” AI video ad maker — it depends on your goal, budget, and the ad format/platform. Below are the top options by use case so you can pick the right one quickly.

Top picks (what they’re best at)
- Synthesia — Best for polished ads with realistic AI presenters and multi‑language voiceovers. Great if you want a spokesperson without hiring actors. Good for B2B and explainer ads. Paid tiers.
- HeyGen / Movio — Similar to Synthesia; strong for lifelike avatars and fast script→video. Choose based on avatar style and pricing.
- Canva Video — Best for beginners and tight budgets. Lots of templates, easy resizing for social platforms, basic AI text‑to‑video and voice. Free tier + affordable Pro.
- InVideo — Best for template-driven social/video ads and quick editing. Large template library and easy text→video workflows.
- Pictory — Best for turning long-form content (webinars, podcasts) into short ad clips automatically. Good auto-captioning and summarization.
- Runway — Best for creative, generative, and advanced AI editing (background removal, generative fill). Good if you need unique visuals or creative effects.
- Promo.com / Shakr / VidMob — Best for scaled ad production and platform-optimized templates (Facebook, TikTok, Instagram). Used by performance marketers and agencies; strong analytics/variants.
- CapCut / Descript — Best free/cheap editing with AI features (transcription, quick cutdowns). CapCut is widely used for TikTok-style ads.

How to choose
- Want a human spokesperson? Pick Synthesia/HeyGen/Movio.
- Need quick social ads from templates? Try Canva, InVideo, Promo.
- Repurpose long content into ads? Use Pictory or Descript.
- Need advanced creative effects or generative visuals? Use Runway.
- Planning high-volume, tested ad variations? Look at Promo, Shakr, or enterprise platforms like VidMob/Celtra.

Other considerations
- Aspect ratios & platform exports (TikTok vs YouTube).
- Languages and TTS quality.
- Brand kit support (fonts, colors, logos).
- Licensing for stock clips/music.
- Budget and whether you need team/collaboration features.

If you tell me your budget, platform (TikTok/FB/YouTube), ad length, and whether you want a human presenter or animated look, I’ll recommend the single best tool and a quick workflow.
